q1.explanationZh: 第二段说导盲犬靠练习才变得有用，“熟能生巧”，所以是通过大量训练学会的。

evidence.quote: Guide dogs practise to be helpful, and practice makes perfect.

q2.explanationZh: 第四段说在学认路之前，导盲犬要先在很多方面受训，因为安全地带路比知道去哪里更重要。

evidence.quote: But before this, guide dogs must receive training in many other areas.

q3.explanationZh: 第五段说如果树枝很大，狗会挡住主人，让他知道前面有东西挡路。

evidence.quote: If it is large, the dog will block the person so that he knows there is something in the way.

q4.explanationZh: 最后一段说狗只是在路的尽头拦住主人，是否安全过马路要由人自己听周围的声音来决定。

evidence.quote: It is then up to the person to listen to their surroundings and decide if it is safe to cross the road.

q5.explanationZh: do one’s shopping 是“购物”，这里要用名词 shopping。

q6.explanationZh: telling the truth 是“说实话”，the 后面要用名词 truth。

q7.explanationZh: 空格修饰动词 accept，要用副词 blindly（盲目地）。

q8.explanationZh: the greatest 后面要用名词 importance（重要性）。

q9.explanationZh: some 后面要名词，guidance 表示“指导，建议”，不可数。

accept: It’s up to you to decide
It is up to you to decide

q10.explanationZh: It’s up to sb. to do sth. 表示“由某人决定做某事”。

accept: find a small path through the forest

q11.explanationZh: manage to do sth. 是“设法做成”，“穿过森林”用 through the forest。

q12.explanationZh: as part of 表示“作为……的一部分”。

accept: Since you know nothing about the place

q13.explanationZh: since 引导原因状语从句，意思是“既然”。

accept: We didn’t realise we had lost our way until we reached
We did not realise we had lost our way until we reached
We didn’t realize we had lost our way until we reached
We did not realize we had lost our way until we reached

q14.explanationZh: not ... until 表示“直到……才”，发现迷路在“到达”之前，所以用过去完成时 had lost。
